title: Cancellation of target-chain bar comparisons
statement: Let i and r be the target-chain inclusion and retraction [def-sc-compact-flat-bar-target-retraction]. If r;i is homotopic to the identity and the target-chain augmentation is invertible in the homotopy category [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], then the full-bar augmentation is invertible there.

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; Cancellation of target-chain bar comparisons.

proof.text: The proved strict identity i;r=id and the supplied homotopy r;i~id make Q(i) invertible, with inverse Q(r). Naturality of augmentation gives Q(i);Q(e)=Q(e_target). Cancel the invertible Q(i) from this invertible composite using IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left.
